implementation.boundary: Clean observed outer contour -> local quadratic tangents -> public fixed-width offset -> piecewise inner boundary. Coarse circle guides observation sampling only.
implementation.support: Red OR white curb evidence; coherent2x2 grass veto; painted flank samples treated as intervals spanning public curb width. Known vehicle-only gaps may be inferred conditionally.
implementation.guards: No extrapolation across missing local fits or clipped frame boundaries; observed obstacles and grass patches veto additions; atan2 branch-cut rotation checked.

public_checks.scope: Finite public synthetic falsification checks; not universal bounds or a safety certificate.

cached_gates.fix: Local contour offset plus grass/curb material disambiguation
A public curb tile can be red OR white; both colours are not required in the local patch
Visible curb-width intervals prevent a painted flank from invalidating all current-vehicle road support

latest_failure.remaining_blocker: Estimated boundary still understates forecast margin near the inner bend. Actual-map margins are only0.595..0.801m; the fixed inset plus observation uncertainty leaves estimates below0.5m. Current clean contour support does not justify a further expansion.

diagnostic_recovery.recovery: Use a separate map-only external comparison, rebuilding contacts and contact friction from the changed map; leave estimated kinematics/history/reference fixed. No rigid-state tolerance or core gate weakened.

next_gate: A more accurate observable boundary/reference reconstruction must pass physical-road overstatement checks and the saved complete decision45 Agent input before another reset. No lower inset, controller gate change or unsupported replay.
privacy: Code, public synthetic tests and aggregates only. Raw pixels, reset identity, actual geometry/state and complete checkpoints remain private.
